src/agent-context.ts.reason: Round-trips this module's own JSON Schema text. No outside input reaches it, and key order is part of the published revision.

src/app.ts.reason: The company-mapping route hands the body to parsePlan inside the operation, after its read-only gate. Parsing in the route would swap the 422 and 503 order.

src/slack-oauth.ts.reason: The Slack callback branches on these error markers, so a schema changes which refusal a null auth.test body gets. Needs a decision.

src/workspace-operations.ts.reason: Slack notification channel read, owned by the notifications work (LIF-1803).

src/attio-oauth.ts.reason: The install exchange runs before any stored credential exists, and the transport in crm-mapping needs one. Merging them needs a design decision.

src/company-mapping/runtime.ts.reason: Company mapping keeps its own HubSpot transport with its own error codes (HUBSPOT_SCHEMA_*, COMPANY_MAPPING_TIMEOUT). Merging it with crm-mapping changes those responses, so it needs a decision.

src/google-mailbox-proof.ts.reason: A second Google key set with its own 5 s timeout and cache settings. Sharing the warmup key set would change both.

src/hubspot-oauth.ts.reason: The install exchange runs before any stored credential exists, and the transport in crm-mapping needs one. Merging them needs a design decision.
